what_it_is: Airbus C-295 is listed in this atlas as a medium tactical transport (in_production). The atlas legacy record attributes it to Airbus Defence and Space (Spain). FAL in India (L1+). Major Indian Tier-1 suppliers qualified for structural sub-assemblies. Engine, avionics, FADEC, and primary mission computer remain imported (L0). India is the second C-295 FAL location globally after Seville.
